responsibility: This installed header provides the scalar AArch64 FP16 ACLE interface for ARMv8.2-A half-precision operations. It defines float16_t and a large set of always-inline wrappers for scalar FP16 arithmetic, comparisons, conversions, rounding, reciprocal helpers, and fused multiply-add/subtract operations, mapping those source-level intrinsics to the corresponding AArch64 builtins within a +fp16 target-option region.
